title: Quizzy
line: An educational app that turns quizzes into a game.
problem: Quizzy is a student-centric educational app that transforms traditional learning into a fun and interactive experience through gamified quizzes. It aims to tackle common challenges like student disengagement and a lack of motivation.
did: I designed an app where users can create or join quiz rooms, compete with friends in real time and track their progress through leaderboards and analytics, all with a clean and minimalist interface.
outcome: A complete interactive prototype that encourages active participation and collaboration in learning.
